resources.string: "Usuvele usebenzisa leli gama lomsebenzisi kule akhawunti \"%s\"."
"Iseva %s idinga ukuba uyivumele ukuba ilawule kude ezinye izici zokuphepha kwedivayisi ye-Android."
"Hlela umbhalo owusebenzisa njalo uma ubhala ama-imeyli"
"Igama lombebenzisi, iphasiwedi, nezinye izilungiselelo zeseva ezingenayo"
"Igama lomsebenzisi, iphasiwedi, nezinye izilungiselelo zeseva eziphumayo"
"Ukhombe i-%1$s isebenzisa u-%2$s, kodwa i-akhawunti ingase isebenzisa u-%3$s"
"Qinisekisa ukuthi igama lomsebenzisi, iphasiwedi, nezilungiselelo ze-akhawunti kulungile."
"Awunayo imvume yokuvumelanisa ngalesisiphakeli. Thintana nomqondisi wesiphakeli sakho ukuze uthole ukwazisa okuningi."
"Isititiketi seklayenti siyadingeka. Ingabe ufuna ukuxhuma kuseva ngesitifiketi seklayenti?"
"Iseva iphendule ngephutha, sicela uhlole igama lakho lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi bese uzama futhi."
"Ufake ikheli leseva elingalungile noma iseva idinga inguqulo yomthetho olandelwayo lowo i-Imeyli engawusekeli."
"Ayikwazanga ukuvula uxhumano kwisiphakeli ngenxa yephutha lokuphepha."
"Le seva idinga izici zokuphepha ezingasekelwa idivayisi yakho ye-Android, kuhlanganisa: %s"
"Layisha okunamathiselwa kwi-imeyili ngokuzenzakalelayo uma uxhunyiwe kukuxhuma kungenazintambo"
"Iseva%s idinga ukuba uyivumele ukuba ilawule kude ezinye izici zokuphepha zedivayisi ye-Android yakho. Ingabe ufuna ukuqedela ukumisa le-akhawunti?"
"Sicela uthayiphe ikheli le-imeyili elilungile kanye nephasiwedi."
"Ayikwazi ukugudluza ngoba ukukhetha kuqukethe ama-akhawunti amaningi."
"Misa ukubonisa izithombe ezisemugqeni ezisuka kubathumeli obavumele ngaphambilini."

"ISEXWAYISO: Yenza kungasebenzi imvume yohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Imeyli ukubhalisa idivaysi yakho kuzosusa wonke ama-akhawunti e-Imeyli ayidingayo, kuhlanganise ne-imeyli yayo, othintana nabo, amakhalenda, izenzakalo, neminye imininingo."
"Thinta futhi ubambe ukukhetha ingxoxo eyodwa, bese uyathinta ukukhetha eziningi."
"Eyodwa noma eyengeziwe yezinamathiseli kumlayezo wakho odluliselwe izolandwa ngaphambi kokuthumelwa."
"Alukho uhlelo lokusebenza olungavula lokhu okunamathiselwe ukuze kubukwe."
"Udinga ukushintsha i-PIN yesikrini sakho sokukhuya noma iphasiwedi ngokushesha, noma idatha ye-%s izosulwa. Ufuna ukuyishintsha manje?"
"\"%s\" idinga ukuba ushintshe iphinikhodi yokuvala isikrini noma iphasiwedi"
"Idatha le-%s lisuliwe kudivayisi. Ungalibuyisa ngokushintsha i-PIN yakho yokukhiya isikrini noma iphasiwedi. Ufuna ukuyishintsha manje?"
"Iphinikhodi noma iphasiwedi yakho yokuvala isikrini iphelelwe isikhathi."
"Ivumela lolu hlelo lokusebenza ukufinyelela kumininingo yakho egciniwe ye-Imeyili, kuhlanganise imiyalezo etholiwe, imiyalezo ethunyelwe, amagama abasebenzisi kanye namaphasiwedi."
"Ngaphambi kokuhlela le-akhawunti ye-imeyili, sicela uvakashele Iwebhusayithi ye-T-Online bese wenza iphasiwedi ukufinyelela kwi-imeyili ye-POP3."
"I-Akhawunti \"%s\" ishintshe izilungiselelo zayo zokuphepha; asikho isenzo somsebenzisi esidingekayo."
"Idivayisi yakho ayinaso isikhala sokulondoloza esanele ukuvumelanisa."
"Ushintsho olwenza kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza nama-akhawunti, hhayi nje ku-Gmail kuphela, luzovumelaniswa phakathi kwewebhu, amanye amadivayisi wakho ne-%1$s yakho."
"Vuliwe, kusukela ngomhla ka-%1$s kuya ngomhla ka-%2$s"

"Le akhawunti ayisethiwe kufika ekuvumelaniseni kokuzenzakalela.\nThinta u-""Vumelanisa manje"" ukuze uvumelanise imeyila kanye, noma ""shintsha izilungiselelo zokuvumelanisa"" ukuze usethe le akhawunti ukuze ivumelanise imeyili ngokuzenzakalela."
